q: Menurut Peraturan Loji CF 2024, pengandung tekanan ialah:
c: Bekas tertutup dengan tekanan lebih tinggi atau lebih rendah daripada tekanan atmosfera
e: Pressure vessel means an enclosed vessel with pressure greater or less than atmospheric pressure.

q: Menurut ASME (2023), tekanan dalam pengandung tekanan boleh diperoleh daripada:
c: Sumber luaran atau melalui penggunaan haba
e: Pressure may be obtained from an external source or by application of heat (direct, indirect or combination).

q: Bekas proses (process vessel) ialah bekas di mana berlaku operasi seperti:
e: Types: storage vessel (store liquids/gases under pressure); process vessel – separation, combining, breaking down, removing.

q: Antara tujuan dandang stim ialah:
c: Membekalkan stim untuk penjanaan kuasa turbin dan haba untuk proses industri
e: Steam boiler purpose: steam for power generation (turbines), heat for industrial processes, heating and sterilization.

q: Dandang stim memerlukan kawalan ketat terhadap:
c: Kualiti air, bekalan bahan api dan pembakaran
e: Key features: high pressure and temperature; safety valves, gauges, water level indicators, blowdown valves; strict control of water quality, fuel supply and combustion.

q: Winch, derik dan davit dikategorikan sebagai:
e: Lifting machinery types: cranes, hoists, lift, winches, derricks, davits, lifting appliances.

q: Jentera angkat penting dalam industri kerana:
c: Meningkatkan kecekapan mengendalikan beban berat yang tidak boleh diurus secara manual
e: Purpose: essential in construction, manufacturing, ports, logistics, mining, shipyards; handling heavy loads.

q: Siapakah yang mengendalikan pengesahan reka bentuk dan pemeriksaan loji CF?
e: Statutory requirements: authorized inspecting bodies handle design verification and inspection.

q: Loji CF mesti mematuhi:
c: Piawaian yang diiktiraf, dengan asas dan sokongan yang mencukupi
e: Design & installation: design verification to DOSH, imported/used plant integrity reports, recognized standards, adequate foundations, essential fittings.

q: CF diperlukan:
e: CF required before operating plant; inspection by DOSH officer or licensed person.

q: Pemeriksaan khas (special inspection) loji CF dijalankan:
e: Maintenance, inspection & repair: initial (pre-use), periodic, and special inspections after major repairs or incidents.

q: Lif dan eskalator semasa pemeriksaan berkala diuji dari segi:
e: Lifting machinery (except lifts/escalators) tested under SWL; lifts/escalators tested for safety devices and operation.

q: Bagi pengandung tekanan, perkara yang perlu dipantau termasuk:
e: Pressure vessels: internal inspections unless designed otherwise; thickness/corrosion monitoring, pressure relief, gauges and safety valves.

q: Ujian beban (Safe Working Load) sebelum penggunaan dan berkala diperlukan bagi:
e: Lifting machinery: pre-use and periodic load tests (SWL) for cranes, hoists and winches.

q: Pemeriksa yang menjalankan pemeriksaan loji CF memerlukan:
c: Kelayakan atau pengalaman kejuruteraan dan dilesenkan
e: Competency: inspections by licensed persons; inspectors require engineering qualifications/experience; competent persons handle design, installation, repair.

q: Yuran dikenakan bagi perkara berikut di bawah peraturan loji CF:
c: Pengesahan reka bentuk, pengeluaran dan pembaharuan CF
e: Fees apply for design verification, CF issuance & renewal; operating without CF is an offence.

q: Dalam letupan loji OCIM Samalaju (Jan 2025), bilangan mangsa ialah:
e: OCIM Jan 2025: hydrogen gas leak from a filter vessel; damage to shelter panels; casualties: none.

q: Kapal bekalan PSV Icon Amara mengalami letupan berhampiran:
e: PSV Icon Amara (Aug 2024): explosion in engine room near Bintulu, Sarawak; 2 killed, 1 severely injured.

q: Bahan yang terlepas dalam kemalangan unit hidroklorinasi OCIM (Ogos 2024) termasuk:
e: OCIM Aug 2024: bottom reactor pipe explosion at hydrochlorination unit – release of hydrogen chloride, steam, solids; 10 injured, 2 died.

q: Langkah kawalan bagi pengandung tekanan termasuk:
c: Memilih pengandung tekanan yang sesuai dengan keperluan proses
e: Preventive and control: control maintenance/repair, training, select suitable pressure vessel per process requirements, appoint competent boiler operator.
